title: BIDS conversion example with toy data
text: Now, use write_task_tsv function generate BIDS-compliant directory files. function performs following actions: Creates output directory (doesn’t already exist). Writes task-specific .tsv file behavioral data (response times, accuracy, etc.). find directory now containing desired files. Notice used little trick called task “reaction” providing name vector. allows defining variables invariant contained data. also added participant information “ignore_variables” want participants.tsv nowhere else.
code: # Output directory  output_dir <- "example_bids"  # Write the task-related tsv files write_task_tsv(data = example_data_checked, bids_dir = output_dir,                 data_type = "beh",                 filename_prefixes = c("sub-", "ses-", "task-"),                 filename_variables = c("participant_id", "session", "reaction"="task"),                path_prefixes = c("sub-", "ses-"),                 path_variables = c("participant_id", "session"),                 ignore_variables = c("age", "sex")) #> Variable task does not exist in the data and will be imputed as reaction #> Task data saved: example_bids/sub-1/ses-1/sub-1_ses-1_task-reaction_beh.tsv #> Task data saved: example_bids/sub-2/ses-1/sub-2_ses-1_task-reaction_beh.tsv #> Task data saved: example_bids/sub-3/ses-1/sub-3_ses-1_task-reaction_beh.tsv #> Task data saved: example_bids/sub-1/ses-2/sub-1_ses-2_task-reaction_beh.tsv #> Task data saved: example_bids/sub-2/ses-2/sub-2_ses-2_task-reaction_beh.tsv #> Task data saved: example_bids/sub-3/ses-2/sub-3_ses-2_task-reaction_beh.tsv

Default c("participant_id", "session"). ignore_variables=c() character vector variables explicitly exclude tsv file. data contains participant information variables, can defined character vector, example ignore_variables =  c("age", "sex"). include_variables=c() character vector variables explicitly include tsv file. can useful case want keep one variables end file name data.
